text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I couldn't run `python3 -m unittest`. I had no shell tool here, so none of the fixes have been run. Please run it to confirm the suite passes.

- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` now converts the year to an int. It was leaving it as a string.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books` now includes `Emma` by Austen (1815, 1 copy). I made up the author, year and copy count because the tests only check the title.
- **`fees.py`:** `late_fee` now multiplies days by `DAILY_FEE`. It was adding them.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` now returns exactly the last `n` events, and an empty list when `n <= 0`. It was returning `n + 1`.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` is now 5, matching the lending-policy comment and the tests.
- **`search.py`:** `normalize` is now imported from `catalog.text`. The old import pointed at a module that doesn't exist.
